message.reasoning:
We need to fix compilation errors. The test class imports JUnit 4 and JUnit 5 stuff, but we don't have those dependencies. Simpler: remove JUnit imports and annotations, and adjust methods. Since they also have a custom main runner that calls methods directly, we can delete JUnit-specific annotations and imports. Also fix assertTrue/assertFalse helper signatures: they currently ignore message param but call themselves recursively causing stack overflow. They should not call themselves. Should implement as simple checks.

Current helper:

private static void assertTrue(boolean condition, String message) {
        assertTrue(condition, "expected true but was false");
    }

This is recursive. Should be:

if (!condition) throw new AssertionError(message);

Similarly for assertFalse.

Also they have overloads used in code: they call assertTrue(closedPosition.isClosed()); without message, but only method defined takes two params. So need overload with single param.

Simplify: define two overloads: assertTrue(boolean) and assertTrue(boolean,String). same for assertFalse.

Also remove imports for JUnit and Mockito. Remove @Test, @BeforeEach, @AfterEach, @DisplayName, @ExtendWith annotations. Keep methods as regular methods; they are called via reflection? In main they use method references testSuite::givenNewPosition_whenIsClosed_thenFalse etc. Those are instance methods, fine.

Also the setupBeforeEach and teardownAfterEach methods are annotated but not used; we can keep them but remove annotations and maybe rename; not needed.

But they also have duplicate setup() and teardown() methods used by main runner. So keep those.

Thus modify: delete import lines for JUnit and Mockito. Remove annotations lines (or comment). Ensure code compiles.

Also need to import java.lang.reflect.Field already there.

Potential other errors: In assertTrue(message) they used assertTrue(condition, "expected true but was false"); but that calls overloaded method with message param; we will implement both.

Implement:

private static void assertTrue(boolean condition) { assertTrue(condition, "expected true but was false"); }

private static void assertTrue(boolean condition, String message) { if (!condition) throw new AssertionError(message); }

Similarly assertFalse.

Also ensure the class is public? Not necessary.

Now adjust imports: remove org.junit.Test, org.junit.jupiter.api.*, org.junit.jupiter.api.extension.ExtendWith, org.mockito.junit.jupiter.MockitoExtension.

Also remove @ExtendWith annotation line.

Also remove @BeforeEach, @AfterEach, @Test, @DisplayName annotations.

Now compile.

Potential missing dependencies: Position, Trade, etc are from same package, assumed present.

Also note that they used DoubleNum.valueOf which returns Num. Should be fine.

Now produce corrected code.
